impact.text: ETH sent to Core is stuck forever.

precondition_sources.text: The pool is initialized at tick 0 with liquidity.
The victim submits a swap with a sqrtRatioLimit set near the current price for slippage protection, and the swap carries a nonzero ETH value via msg.value.

intent_sources.text: ETH sent to Core must remain recoverable rather than becoming permanently stuck with no recovery mechanism.
